text:
marta: hi all, marta here — first week! quick Q: where should i post requests for a desk/monitor vs access to internal repos? also which bots should i subscribe to as a new hire?

leo: welcome! desk/monitor requests go to #people-ops (they handle physical stuff). Repo access and infra roles -> #eng-infra, use the access template. For secrets/keys use #security.

onboarding-bot: Run `onboard checklist` to get the links for VPN, Okta, repo access, and buddy contact. To subscribe: DM /onboard subscribe.

marta: thanks — any tips on not getting spammed by bots?

sam: mute deploy and monitoring bots until you need them. Star channels you use, and pin onboarding docs. If you accidentally subscribe to alerts, use channel settings -> mute or unsubscribe.

anya: etiquette: use threads for follow-ups so channels stay readable. Use :thumbsup: reactions for quick ack. For multi-team questions start in the most relevant channel and @mention the team.

marta: got it — where do i ask about badge pickup?

leo: #people-ops again, but DM them if it's time-sensitive. For badge-related timing include your office location and manager.

marta: perfect, thanks everyone.
